formula_checks.name: basePay
formula_checks.why: The household tax row uses gross×household rate even in mixed entered/calculated take-home mode, while actual implied deductions can differ by earner. Its bracket is wages-only despite the owner’s all-income band rule.
formula_checks.should_be: Expose each entered/calculated component distinctly, reconcile gross−deductions−401(k)=take-home, and use one all-taxable-income band producer.

formula_checks.name: periodsAYear
formula_checks.why: Documented run-rate conversion: 52 weekly/26 fortnightly/12 monthly/1 yearly. Hourly2080 means the explicitly assumed40×52 and is not variable-hours gross.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: perMonth
formula_checks.why: The arithmetic converts a known pay rhythm correctly. Missing hours or pay rhythm silently become 40 hours or monthly pay without an assumption flag.
formula_checks.should_be: Keep the conversion for known inputs; identify the assumed hours/frequency or refuse an unqualified figure.

formula_checks.name: monthsOf
formula_checks.why: Blank amounts become0, making an unentered cell indistinguishable from confirmed unpaid time.
formula_checks.should_be: Keep blank as missing with an entered flag; preserve explicit zero.

formula_checks.name: grossByMonth
formula_checks.why: Purpose promises twelve identical months for steady pay, but formula returns one typical row; consumers that sum versus annualize can disagree.
formula_checks.should_be: Specify a typical-row domain versus a dated-calendar domain, or always return a complete dated year.

formula_checks.name: annualisedGross
formula_checks.why: Average of a partial or14-month table ×12 is a run-rate, not the actual tax-year wages; it can disagree with salaryAnnual on known dated cells.
formula_checks.should_be: For tax brackets sum the actual tax-year months; label any separate rolling/partial run-rate and its coverage.

formula_checks.name: takeHomeAsEntered
formula_checks.why: Preserves positive typed monthly take-home, but rejects a confirmed0 and can use full-year contributions/averages for partial-year pay.
formula_checks.should_be: Treat entered0 as known; use matching wage/contribution dates and distinguish typical from annual average.

formula_checks.name: deductionsFromPay
formula_checks.why: Yearly gross−12×monthly401(k)−12×typical take-home is wrong for employment gaps; a partially covered year is not a full-year observation.
formula_checks.should_be: Use the actual annual totals for the same paid months, leaving unknown take-home periods incomplete.

formula_checks.name: payFiguresAgree
formula_checks.why: Returns at the first warning and can skip a later actual failure; also subtracts typical take-home and401(k) in unpaid months without a matching table.
formula_checks.should_be: Inspect all months for failure before issuing any warning, and align take-home/contributions with the months paid.

formula_checks.name: earnerPay
formula_checks.why: Combines correctly scoped primitives on a full-year complete record, but inherits run-rate and part-year deduction problems.
formula_checks.should_be: Use common calendar-year coverage and preserve entered/calculated status per earner.

formula_checks.name: payrollTaxWithheld
formula_checks.why: Correct employee withholding at one employer using known Social-Security/Medicare wages. It is not household final Additional Medicare liability; pretax benefit wage-base differences are outside the one-number input.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: entryFromWage
formula_checks.why: Preserves each wage’s input fields and canonical month table in one pay entry; it should not create a separate tax calculation.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: enteredLandsAnnual
formula_checks.why: Multiplies typical take-home by12 and treats entered0 as absent, despite paid-month gaps and year-specific records.
formula_checks.should_be: Sum dated take-home amounts for the year, or use typical take-home only in paid months.

formula_checks.name: rateInForce
formula_checks.why: Precedence is correct for complete full-year wages. Implied rates inherit12-month contribution/take-home errors; a rate of0 for no known taxable income needs an explicit absence state.
formula_checks.should_be: Correct annual sources and contributions, preserve known0 versus absent input and propagate coverage; keep typed rate precedence.

The whole income surface redesigned. Six decisions:
1. Base pay becomes a full screen with one expandable section per earner — gross, 401(k), employer match, and what actually lands.
